glossdef.p: At a minimum you will need a mouse, keyboard, and monitor. Those do not come free with the case outside of a Micro Center bundle. You might also consider getting a DVD drive to make installing software on your new machine easier. When looking at monitors keep in mind how much you’re investing into your GPU. If you’re spending $900 on a high-end GPU you will also want a high-end monitor to display your crisp graphics.
